title: Tapscript threshold

schema.script: (<key> CHECKSIGVERIFY)* <key> CHECKSIG (<key> CHECKSIGADD)+ then an optional k and GREATERTHANOREQUAL, NUMEQUAL, or EQUAL

note: The check matches 32-byte keys: any number of CHECKSIGVERIFY, one CHECKSIG, then at least one CHECKSIGADD, at most 20 keys in all. The threshold compare may be GREATERTHANOREQUAL, NUMEQUAL, or EQUAL, and it may be absent. This clears the unverified-key mark on that leaf. Not an insert package.
